simple.meaning: פָּגַע (pâgaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to impinge , by accident or violence, or (figuratively) by importunity.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 46 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Joshua, Judges, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 23:8. Its contexts include family line, sacrifice, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פָּגַע (H6293).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: פָּגַע (pâgaʻ) / H6293 is traced through Genesis 23:8, Genesis 28:11, Genesis 32:2, Exodus 5:3 as a generated source-based concept entry.
